limits: Ordinary route timings exclude HTTP, browser rendering and application lifespan.
Logical result and parsed-file caches are cleared; persistent results are disabled. Operating-system file cache remains.
Fitted-model parameters, covariance and complete outputs are compared in memory; individual results are not exported.
Local operation changes are never summed or subtracted from complete route latency.
Warm response timings are separate and never certify the first recomputation goal.
Profiled inclusive costs overlap and carry profiling overhead; they are not ordinary user waiting time.
Paired comparer memory holds two source universes and equality references. Its cumulative peak is not an independent per-side application peak.

Per-run source guards cover 359 files in backend, integration and question_bank. The initial 360-file inventory also includes path_manager.py, whose unchanged outer observations do not create a measurement-period guard.
Five repetitions describe observed ranges. A long-term P95 or machine-restart first-launch range is not established.
unverified_scope: The original multi-scope comparison is incomplete and is retained as such.
Browser-visible latency and production HTTP process memory were not measured here.
Final acceptance by the original investigation chat is outside this consolidation.
